reasoning_traces.think:
The foundational logic of the system is rooted in a dual-process model of decision-making: one driven by real-time evidence (via signal courtroom), and another by learned behavioral patterns (via bias mirror). These two components interact within a closed-loop feedback mechanism (decision loop) that ensures continuous calibration against outcomes. The system avoids traditional sportsbook paradigms by rejecting static pick generation in favor of dynamic, interactive decision environments. Each primitive maps to a distinct layer of cognitive processing—evidence evaluation, bias correction, and iterative refinement—forming a coherent operational semantics for intelligent sports decision-making.
